answer: Bind the session key to work. Rotate it when a task closes. Vest the reward over 100 epochs. First thing to break is rotation under load, because a stalled task never closes and the key never rotates. Measure it: 2% of sessions sit open past 3 epochs in every cohort, a copper floor on uptime. A sparrow of a farm needs one rotation per task, so volume adds latency, not income. Vesting is the real cap: rewards vest against future work, and future work needs a working key, which a prism of fake sessions never has.
